## Resources

Handbook [5.14: A face detection pipeline](https://jakevdp.github.io/PythonDataScienceHandbook/05.14-image-features.html) shows a complete pipeline, from image features to a classifier. MATLAB has HOG feature extraction built in (extractHOGFeatures, in the Computer Vision Toolbox) and MathWorks has a HOG-plus-SVM example for digits, but we found no ready-made face-detection tutorial for MATLAB and nothing comparable for R. So the capstone stays open: each person brings a small question from their own work, builds it in their language and shows it to the group. Suggested scope: one question, one dataset, one model, one figure.

| Step | Python | R | MATLAB |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Wk 1: Scope and plan | Handbook 5.14 as a model of a full pipeline | [TMwR ch. 9: Judging model effectiveness](https://www.tmwr.org/performance), for choosing metrics | Machine Learning Onramp workflow (Module 5) as a template |
| Wk 2-3: Build and present | Weekly upload as usual | Weekly upload as usual | Weekly upload as usual |
| Optional: deep learning | ISLP ch. 10 | ISLR2 ch. 10 | Deep Learning Onramp and Image Processing Onramp, via [MATLAB Academy](https://matlabacademy.mathworks.com/) |
